## Summary
Full-Stack Developer with production experience shipping complete web applications — from backend APIs and database architecture to responsive frontends and cloud deployment. Independently built and launched multiple live SaaS products and client platforms. Experienced with modern TypeScript stack (Next.js, Prisma, PostgreSQL) and Java/Spring Boot backend systems. Integrates AI (Claude, Gemini) as a product feature. Practises thorough testing (Vitest, Playwright E2E) to catch bugs early and minimise production issues. Uses AI-assisted development (Claude Code, Cursor) as a core workflow multiplier.
